name: Assault Mermaid
source:
A mermaid princess swears revenge against the pirates who abducted her sister. Having gained the power to fight in exchange for her voice, what kind of conclusion awaits her journey...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/2240]Freem[/url]]
translation:
一位人鱼公主立誓要向掳走姐姐的海盗复仇。以自己的声音为代价换取了战斗之力的她，在旅途的尽头究竟会迎来怎样的结局……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/2240]Freem[/url]]
